children: UK fire protection equipment provider's H1 revenue grew 9.2% yr/yr to £127.6 mln
Operating profit for H1 rose 13.7% yr/yr to £14.1 mln
Company attributed growth to improved service performance and favorable currency movements
Company says demand for its products and services remains strong as they are non-discretionary
Company continues to experience upward input price pressures despite moderating inflation
Improved service performance is expected to drive organic growth in the service pool
CURRENCY MOVEMENT - Co said favorable Euro to Sterling exchange rate boosted reported revenue and profit
SERVICE PERFORMANCE - Improved service performance from newly recruited engineers drove organic growth in the service pool
ACQUISITIONS - Acquisitions in the Netherlands and UK strengthened market presence
INPUT COSTS - Upward input price pressures persisted, with supply price increases passed on to customers where possible
